# Memory Index

- [Compost bin setup](compost-bin-setup.md) — two-bin hot rotation in the north corner; turn weekly, keep browns:greens ~3:1

- [Hedge trimmer schedule](hedge-trimmer-schedule.md) — **Boxwoods trimmed TWICE a year (late spring after the first flush + late summer), NEVER in a heat wave because the cut faces scorch; use the CORDLESS trimmer which must be charged the night before since it does not hold charge in storage; blade-oil after every single session; the two trims go on the calendar and the late-summer one must not slip past the first cold snap; see also the old mower ritual and the compost rotation which share the same seasonal calendar block that the owner reviews every quarter when he plans the yard work weekends**

- [Garden hose leak](garden-hose-leak.md) — **ROOT CAUSE finally CONFIRMED 2026-05-30: a cracked brass Y-splitter at the far spigot, NOT the hose and NOT the regulator. The 2026-04-02 kinked-hose theory was WRONG (re-coiling changed nothing); the regulator swap was a RED HERRING (near spigot pressure was always fine both times, which should have pointed at the splitter sooner); cleaning the aerator was cosmetic. Dead-ends never to re-try: re-coil/replace hose, swap regulator, clean aerator. If far-bed pressure drops again check the Y-splitter FIRST. Same brass-fitting failure mode later showed up on the sprinkler zone-3 manifold so treat all brass fittings on the property as age-failing.**

- [Sprinkler timer](sprinkler-timer.md) — zone 3 ran dry; same cracked-brass-fitting root cause as the hose (manifold, not the timer program)

- [Old mower brand](old-mower-brand.md) — GreenBlade 2200 gas mower choke ritual (full choke first pull, half next two, then off; prime 3x cold)

- [Patio umbrella warranty](patio-umbrella-warranty.md) — 5-year frame warranty (fabric 2yr); receipt in the garage file box; register within 90 days
